paragraphs: Imi bar Chinena: Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 11.
Rav Dimi bar Chinena: [Eruvin 61a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.61a.18-19). Rav Huna bar Chinena: [Berakhot 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.30a.19).
Rav Chana bar Chinena: [Pesachim 106b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.106b.2). Ulla bar Chinena: [Sukkah 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.33a.4).
Rav Ukva bar Chinena: [Pesachim 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.91a.15). Ravin bar Chinena: [Pesachim 109b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.109b.2).[^2]

notes.text: The Megillah 1:11 locator is Jerusalem Talmud. Saved Davidson Berakhot 30a fully writes Rav Huna bar Chinena, supporting that occurrence’s expansion in p003.
The consulted Shabbat has Ika bar Chananya, and Menachot gives Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Chinena. These are the corresponding name variants in the passages grouped by Hyman.
